name: Resistance to Genocide Interdisciplinary Minor
intro: To resist genocide effectively, we need to understand its history — the factors that have brought it about and those that have enabled people to prevent, resist or recuperate from mass violence. This interdisciplinary minor draws upon USC faculty in a dozen academic units researching the causes, results and representations of attempted genocide as well as resistance to genocidal mass violence.
